name: io.github.FlagQuantum/flagquantum-mcp-server
title: FlagQuantum MCP Server
description: Build, compile, serialize and plan FlagQuantum circuits locally. No credentials, no network, no hardware submission.

environmentVariables.name: FLAGQUANTUM_MCP_MAX_QUBITS
environmentVariables.description: Largest circuit width the server will process. Defaults to 24.

environmentVariables.name: FLAGQUANTUM_MCP_MAX_GATES
environmentVariables.description: Largest instruction count the server will process. Defaults to 10000.

environmentVariables.name: FLAGQUANTUM_MCP_MAX_IR_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Largest serialized circuit payload accepted, in bytes. Defaults to 262144.
